imgDesc.text: In the Snezhnaya Adventure Journal, you can view your ongoing and available quests in Snezhnaya. This is also where you can collect corresponding rewards after completing Archon Quests and World Quests.

The Experiences section of your Snezhnaya Adventure Journal. Here, you can find the Meeting Points you have discovered while exploring Snezhnaya. Additionally, you can also view in this section any Special Recruitment Projects that can be done this week.

The Shadow Realm History section of your Snezhnaya Adventure Journal. Here, you can find the Shadow Realms and even more dangerous Shadow Realms you have uncovered while exploring Snezhnaya, and quick-travel to any of these realms for a good ol' cleanup operation.

The Snezhnaya Adventure Journal also allows you to look up the temperatures of the current area. In low-temperature locations, the Eye of Graeae will expend Kresnik Energy to regulate body temperature. Kresnik Energy depletes more quickly in Frigid Zones, and in Subzero Zones, Kresnik Energy will be depleted even more quickly and lead to catastrophic effects. Therefore, do keep an eye on the environmental temperature where you're going!
